recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片白血球極多、幾乎佔滿視野，可見從骨髓球、中骨髓球、後骨髓球到帶狀與分葉中性球的完整成熟階段，並有嗜鹼性球，呈「骨髓在血液中」的樣貌，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）的高白血球。
features: Marked leukocytosis with white cells crowding the field
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Myelocytes predominate among immature forms (myelocyte bulge); blasts not increased in this field
Occasional nucleated red cells; red cells compressed between leukocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic population spanning myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with a prominence of myelocytes. Basophils are present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Granulocytes lack significant dysplasia or toxic change. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with hyperleukocytosis; confirmation of BCR::ABL1 by FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with a metamyelocyte/band predominance, no basophilia, and lack BCR::ABL1.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia with little basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with less than 10% immature granulocytes and harbors CSF3R mutation.
